document.about: ROHM DC/DC converter product guide. Its symbols (×, ±, −, ＋, °, Ω, ：, ’) are set in a Japanese face, ShinGoPro, embedded as a CID font with no ToUnicode map, its CIDs Adobe-Japan1's.

notes: 2026-11-28 (#644): a CID font with no ToUnicode map, its CIDs an Adobe collection's (/CIDSystemInfo), is read through that collection's map of CIDs to Unicode (Adobe-Japan1-UCS2 and the others).

checks.issue: `1.76mm(Typ)×1.56mm(Typ)×0.57mm(Max)` read `1.76mm(Typ)1.56mm(Typ)0.57mm(Max)`: the face's × (CID 695) read as nothing.
